name: Michael Ray Williams
background: Michael Ray Williams ran as the Constitution Party nominee for Senate District 11 in 2022 and lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. His Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Rawlins mailing address. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the filings and coverage reviewed for this Profile.
